Sizes

Size accepts the InputFieldSize constants. It scales the number box and the slider together.

Usage 

@uiForm.NumberRangeInputField(uiForm.NumberRangeInputFieldSettings{
	InputName:       "cpuCores",
	Label:           "CPU",
	TwoWayStatePath: "cpuCores",

	// OptionalFields
	Size: uiForm.InputFieldSizeSm,
})

slider-appearance:
Slider Appearance

Thumb and Track take the RangeSlider appearance structs, so the field slider takes the same colors, value bubble, tick marks, tooltip, and bounds labels. The field still owns the value, the bounds, the size, and the accessible name.

Usage 

@uiForm.NumberRangeInputField(uiForm.NumberRangeInputFieldSettings{
	InputName:       "cpuQuota",
	Label:           "CPU Quota",
	TwoWayStatePath: "cpuQuota",

	// OptionalFields
	Min: "10",
	Max: "400",
	Thumb: uiControl.RangeSliderThumbSettings{
		BackgroundColor:    "sky-500",
		ValueBubbleEnabled: true,
	},
	Track: uiControl.RangeSliderTrackSettings{
		FillColor:    "sky-500",
		TicksEnabled: true,
		TickStep:     "50",
		TooltipEnabled: true,
	},
})

slider-display:
Slider Display

SliderDisplay picks when the slider renders. Responsive hides the slider while the field container is narrower than 24rem. Hidden keeps only the number box.

Usage 

@uiForm.NumberRangeInputField(uiForm.NumberRangeInputFieldSettings{
	InputName:       "memoryLimit",
	Label:           "Memory",
	TwoWayStatePath: "memoryLimit",

	// OptionalFields
	Min:           "512",
	Max:           "8192",
	Step:          "256",
	UnitSuffix:    "MiB",
	SliderDisplay: uiForm.NumberRangeInputFieldSliderDisplayResponsive,
})
